name: Global Methodist Church
source_policy: Official GMC sources only (globalmethodist.org): the Book of Doctrines and Discipline (latest final edition linked from globalmethodist.org) and the Who We Are page.

nuance.title: Connectional, without a trust clause
paragraphs: The GMC is connectional: its General Conference legislates for the whole church and the Book of Doctrines and Discipline binds its conferences, clergy and congregations. Governance is graded BINDING.
Unlike the UMC, the GMC has no trust clause. Local churches hold their own property.
The GMC defines marriage as one man and one woman, and it ordains women. Gender and Leadership are graded RED on that line; a church's own evidence still decides its own rating.

scripture.note: No validated official quote maps to a published rule.

rule.text: The official confession affirms Christ is fully God and fully man (also worded "truly God and truly man" or "very God and very man") → GREEN.
The body ordains women to pastoral office → RED minimum (same line as "Female senior pastor → RED minimum.").

The official confession affirms justification by grace through faith alone in Christ alone (also worded "justified by faith only", not by works, or justification defined as God's gracious acquittal of sinners who repent and believe in Christ) → GREEN.

ledger.quote: The Global Methodist Church is committed to the Lordship of Jesus Christ, the inspiration and authority of the Scriptures
We believe in Jesus Christ, truly God and truly man, in whom the divine and human natures are perfectly and inseparably united.
Wherefore, that we are justified by faith, only, is a most wholesome doctrine, and very full of comfort.
We are accounted righteous before God only for the merit of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, by faith, and not for our own works or deservings.
It is out of the faith and witness of the congregation that men and women respond to God’s call to ordained ministry.
We believe that human sexuality is a gift of God that is to be affirmed as it is exercised within the legal and spiritual covenant of a loving and monogamous marriage between one man and one woman
(g) Engaging in sexual activities outside the bonds of a loving and monogamous marriage between one man and one woman
The Global Methodist Church exists to make disciples of Jesus Christ and spread scriptural holiness across the globe.
We are committed to carry out the Great Commission of Jesus in Matthew 28 to go into all the world to make disciples of Christ
The General Conference shall have full legislative power over all matters that are distinctly connectional
There is no trust clause for property held by local churches, annual conferences, connectional commissions, or any other entities of the Global Methodist Church.
